record.question: Answer the following: (a) What are the different kinds of travelling allowance that may be drawn in various circumstances by Govt. servants (b) What do you mean by 'daily allowance'? What is the admissibility of daily allowance in the following? i) Absence not exceeding 6 hours ii) Absence exceeding 6 hours but not exceeding 12 hours iii) Absence exceeding 12 hours (c) What are the elements of transfer TA that may be drawn on regular transfer by a Govt. servant? (d) What do you mean by mileage allowance? Discuss the principles for calculation of mileage allowance
